findings.issue: All nutrient-nutrient interactions are silently skipped when no drug or condition criteria exist
findings.required_fix: Implement quantified co-nutrient exposure rules and unresolved-quantity blocks

findings.issue: Ingredient class multivitamin_mineral treated as if vitamin K content confirmed
findings.required_fix: Require verified actual label composition; absent label must be unknown and block personalized recommendation, not assert an interaction as fact

findings.issue: NO_MATCHES_FOUND_NOT_CLEARED returns no matches but cannot distinguish unmapped medicine synonyms, unknown brands, or unrecognized drug classes
findings.required_fix: Use clinically validated medication normalization and explicit unresolved-item tracking

findings.issue: The draft interaction catalog includes zinc-copper as if co-presence itself were a risk; clinically relevant problem is high prolonged zinc exposure causing copper deficiency
findings.required_fix: Represent dose and duration with source-supported conditional rules

findings.issue: The engine cannot validate per-rule evidence URL, source date, product composition or exposure quantity
findings.required_fix: Require structured source metadata, label provenance, elemental amount and audit timestamps

findings.issue: PersonalizedRecommendationAllowed always false, so engine currently cannot be integrated as a production decision engine
findings.required_fix: Keep fail-closed until separate reviewed authorization pipeline is implemented

references.claim: Zinc/iron timing and high-zinc copper risk
